stance_rationale: As an alpha package, this is not approvable: the required Date×Ticker alpha_scores artifact, IC diagnostics, challenge_note, and AX-008 triangulation are missing. The regime time-series artifact is real and PIT-lagged in parts, but it is being used to justify a defensive overlay despite a failed lead-time gate and no optimizer/risk proof.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Required qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_012/alpha_scores.parquet is absent. stage_artifacts/WT_D20260508_012/regime_indicator_timeseries.parquet has 3990 daily Date rows from 2010-01-04 to 2026-04-23, but it is Date-only regime state, not Date×Ticker×score alpha.

rf_alpha_audit.RF-A2: FAIL_UNVERIFIABLE: composite ICIR versus best single factor is not reported.
rf_alpha_audit.RF-A3: FAIL_UNVERIFIABLE: recent 3Y ICIR versus full ICIR is not reported.
rf_alpha_audit.RF-A4: FAIL_UNVERIFIABLE: no sector-neutral ICIR test exists.
rf_alpha_audit.RF-A5: FAIL_UNVERIFIABLE: no top-decile liquidity or Date×Ticker portfolio evidence exists.
rf_alpha_audit.RF-A6: FAIL: Harvey t, DSR, 5-spec regression, and threshold/beta selection robustness are absent.
rf_alpha_audit.RF-A7: FAIL: required alpha_scores.parquet and weights.csv schedule are absent; regime artifact cannot substitute for alpha schedule verification.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: factor_specs and build scripts use manual sign transforms: -bkm_skew_30d, pmax(-bkm_skew_30d,0), and -(T2_iv_atm - T1_iv_atm); Z_Score_Aligned is not used.
regime_indicator_timeseries.parquet has no Usable_Date column or availability audit proving option-derived fields were usable before decision date.
build_alpha_package_draft.R directly reads stage parquet artifacts, including prior alpha_scores.parquet; no load_month_factors() route is evidenced.
build_option_tail_regime.R computes O_t_lag1 = shift(O_t, 1L) and maps regime_state from O_t_lag1.
No financial-statement factor fields are used in the regime formula.

critical_concerns.description: The package is labeled alpha but ships alpha_vector={}, confidence_vector={}, and no required Date×Ticker×score alpha_scores.parquet; this fails the alpha-package time-series contract rather than merely needing a minor artifact rename.

selection_objective is rank_ic, yet rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey t, DSR, monotonicity, and sub-period stability are all absent; recall/false-positive stress detection is not a substitute for alpha IC diagnostics.
Manual sign reversals are explicit in the formulas, directly conflicting with the C13 requirement to avoid NEGATE_FACTORS/manual sign flips and use aligned factor definitions.

The strict validation gate fails: mean lead time is -4.6 days and median is -14 days, while overall_strict_5gate_pass=false. Marking overall_gate_pass=true by declaring the lead-time gate inappropriate is a silent gate override.
AX-008 is not met: the package itself reports only 1/3 triangulation with Forge and Architect pending, below the required 2-source PASS threshold.
challenge_note.md is absent for WT-D20260508_012, so RF-A1 through RF-A7 are not independently surfaced in the required No Silent Override channel.

Core references are journal-level citations without page/equation mapping, while beta_tail and top-decile thresholds are justified by 'academic convention'; this is not enough to validate the KR overlay mechanism.
Artifact lineage records a reproduction command sourcing qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260508_012/run_all.R, but that file is absent, so the package is not reproducible from its own lineage.

The orthogonality claim is overstated: cor_with_m4_combined_regime=0.5361 exceeds the role prompt's <0.5 recommendation for existing active strategy correlation, yet the package calls the signal genuinely new information.

supporting_arguments: regime_indicator_timeseries.parquet exists with 3990 unique daily dates, no duplicate Date rows, and max Date 2026-04-23, which is not future-dated versus 2026-05-08.
The actual regime artifact uses O_t_lag1 and has 3486 non-null regime_state rows after burn-in, so the daily regime series is not a single-row snapshot.
artifact_lineage.json hash for alpha_package_draft.json matches the current file hash.
unresolved_disputes: Whether this task should be judged as an alpha package or formally reclassified as a regime-indicator discovery artifact with a different acceptance schema.
Whether C13 manual sign transforms are allowed for option-derived regime variables; the current alpha prompt says they are not.
Whether the six in-window stress episodes and threshold choices were fixed ex ante rather than selected after seeing the detection table.
Whether Layer D beta_tail values improve SR/MDD/turnover after 15 bps costs and hard turnover constraints.
Whether qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_012 artifacts were omitted accidentally or intentionally replaced by stage_artifacts/WT_D20260508_012.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that 5/6 stress recall and 9.7% false-positive rate can justify an alpha-package PASS and Layer D risk cap despite missing IC diagnostics, missing alpha_scores, failed lead-time gate, and AX-008 only at 1/3.
rebuttal_required: Provide the required Date×Ticker×score alpha_scores.parquet, or formally re-scope the deliverable away from alpha_critic gates.
Add rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey t, DSR, monotonicity, sub_stability, and recent-3Y versus full-sample diagnostics, or mark them explicitly N/A with governance approval.
Create challenge_note.md for WT-D20260508_012 covering RF-A1 through RF-A7.
Resolve C13 by replacing manual sign flips with approved aligned factors, or document an explicit C13 exemption for option-regime variables.
Explain why overall_gate_pass can be true when lead_time_pass and overall_strict_5gate_pass are false.
Repair lineage reproducibility by adding the referenced run_all.R or changing the reproduction_command to an existing script.
Obtain at least one additional independent PASS so AX-008 reaches 2/3.
rationalization_red_flags: Lead-time gate inappropriate for fast-crash heterogeneous mix
Burn-in cannot be shortened without compromising statistical validity
Pillars + thresholds derived from academic convention

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Claude's package is directionally useful as a daily option-tail regime artifact, but it should not be accepted as an alpha package until the missing alpha contract, strict-gate policy, and independent triangulation are resolved.
